attributes.description: Is inference keeping up? Trained-model deployment queue, throughput and estimated utilisation (sampled every minute by the integration's ML inference statistics input into metrics-claude_code_transcripts.inference_stats-*), plus per-prompt inference durations measured in the claude-code-transcript / claude-prompt-classify pipelines (claude_code.inference.*). Est. utilisation = uncached req/min x lifetime avg uncached ms / (60000 x allocations).
